module: Closed-loop regulator of a linear hydraulic cylinder (type "auxiliary"). A PID compares the average extension of the cylinders (powertrain hydraulic consumers) to a target and writes the valve command into electrics.values. A modder sets the target with setCylinderTargetExtendPercent.
notes: jbeam keys (default): cylinders (list of hydraulic consumer names), cylinderValveElectricsName ("cylinderValve"), cylinderPositionMin (0), cylinderPositionMax (1), targetExtendPercentInitial (0), cylinderPIDKp (0.5), cylinderPIDKi (0.3), cylinderPIDKd (0.01).
PID output bounded to -1..1 and reset to 0 below 0.001. If no cylinder is found, updateFixedStep is set to nil.

init.desc: Creates the PID, finds the cylinders and reads the parameters.

reset.desc: Resets the valve to 0, the target to the initial value and the PID to zero.

updateFixedStep.desc: Computes the valve command from the average extension of the cylinders and writes it into electrics.values.

setCylinderTargetExtendPercent.desc: Sets the target extension of the cylinders.
